SELECT
    ingestion_id,
    source_container,
    source_folder,
    source_file_name,
    sink_container,
    sink_folder,
    sink_file_name,
    load_type,
    watermark_column,
    last_watermark_value
FROM dbo.ingestion_config
WHERE source_folder = 'source/customers'
  AND is_active = 1;
